description: Calculate UK Capital Gains Tax on selling an asset (residential property, shares, a business qualifying for Business Asset Disposal Relief, or other assets) for a tax year: the gain after costs, losses and the annual exempt amount, tax at each rate given other income, and the payment deadline.

allowableCosts.description: Costs of buying, improving and selling

disposalDate.description: Disposal date; only matters in 2024-25, when rates changed on 30 October 2024

otherIncome.description: Taxable income in the year, which sets the rate

taxYear.description: UK tax year, e.g. "2026-27". Defaults to the current one.

name: calculate_capital_gains_tax
title: Calculate Capital Gains Tax
